competitors.name: Swiggy / Zomato
competitors.description: Massive food aggregator platforms with broad restaurant selection.
competitors.differentiation: Generic delivery apps lack hostel batching, specialized student meal subscriptions, and low-cost pricing.
strengths: Deep financial capital and logistics scale
weaknesses: No focus on healthy daily student mess plans

competitors.name: Local Campus Canteens
competitors.differentiation: NutriNest provides variety across multiple local vendors with digital ordering and hygiene ratings.
weaknesses: Poor hygiene oversight and limited operating hours

analysis_summary: NutriNest's primary moat lies in hostel-level batch delivery economics and curated student mess subscriptions that incumbent food apps cannot easily copy without diluting their core model.
